input.oldString:
# Check for Flatpak support
if command -v flatpak &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Flatpak detected. Scanning installed applications..."
    flatpak_apps=$(flatpak list --app --columns=application | tail -n +1)
    flatpak_count=$(echo "$flatpak_apps" | wc -l)
    echo "Installed Flatpak applications: $flatpak_count"
    echo ""

    if [[ $flatpak_count -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Flatpak applications (may include proprietary software):"
        echo ""
        for app in $flatpak_apps; do
            echo "- $app"
        done
    else
        echo "No Flatpak applications installed."
    fi
else
    echo "Flatpak not installed or not in PATH."
fi
input.newString:
# Function to check if a license is free
is_free_license() {
    local license="$1"
    # List of common free licenses (case insensitive)
    free_licenses=("GPL" "LGPL" "MIT" "BSD" "Apache" "ISC" "CC0" "Public Domain" "WTFPL" "Zlib" "Boost")
    for free in "${free_licenses[@]}"; do
        if [[ "${license,,}" == *"${free,,}"* ]]; then
            return 0  # free
        fi
    done
    return 1  # proprietary
}

# Check for Flatpak support
if command -v flatpak &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Flatpak detected. Scanning installed applications..."
    flatpak_apps=$(flatpak list --app --columns=application | tail -n +1)
    flatpak_count=$(echo "$flatpak_apps" | wc -l)
    echo "Installed Flatpak applications: $flatpak_count"
    echo ""

    if [[ $flatpak_count -gt 0 ]]; then
        proprietary_flatpak=()
        free_flatpak=()
        for app in $flatpak_apps; do
            license=$(flatpak info "$app" 2>/dev/null | grep "License:" | awk '{print $2}')
            if [[ -z "$license" ]]; then
                license="Unknown"
            fi
            if is_free_license "$license"; then
                free_flatpak+=("$app ($license)")
            else
                proprietary_flatpak+=("$app ($license)")
            fi
        done

        if [[ ${#proprietary_flatpak[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
            echo "Potentially proprietary Flatpak applications:"
            for app in "${proprietary_flatpak[@]}"; do
                echo "- $app"
            done
            echo ""
        fi

        if [[ ${#free_flatpak[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
            echo "Free software Flatpak applications:"
            for app in "${free_flatpak[@]}"; do
                echo "- $app"
            done
            echo ""
        fi
    else
        echo "No Flatpak applications installed."
    fi
else
    echo "Flatpak not installed or not in PATH."
fi
